# Version matrix

The version data drupilot reads: one `config/targets/<major>.json` per Drupal major and `config/php/versions.json` (their shape is in `schemas/`; the `data` gate checks them, and `scripts/dev/refresh-data.sh` regenerates the values it can read from git.drupalcode.org and packagist). Only a value marked verified, and never *announced* (a statement about a release that does not exist yet), may drive a hard gate. A value left blank is unknown: drupilot detects it at runtime and never assumes it.
